## 更新内容

- 废标项检查支持从技术方案项目读取招标文件技术要求。
- 招标文件绑定技术方案项目后，可自动匹配并读取该项目生成的技术方案正文，无需重复选择。
- 未找到已生成方案时提供明确提示，避免无响应操作。
- 增加 AI 文本请求的可恢复失败重试，覆盖网络错误、限流和服务端临时错误。
- 增加长文本分段处理与 JSON 结果合并，降低大文档分析失败风险。
- 完善项目库数据库迁移保护，确保升级不影响其他项目数据。

## What's Changed

- Rejection check can now read tender technical requirements from a selected technical-plan project.
- Once a tender document is linked to a technical-plan project, the generated technical solution is matched and imported automatically without another project selection.
- Clear feedback is shown when no generated solution is available.
- Added recoverable retry handling for AI text requests, including network errors, rate limits, and temporary server failures.
- Added long-text segmentation and JSON result merging to improve large-document analysis reliability.
- Hardened project-database migrations so upgrades do not affect unrelated project data.
